content: Why Pakistani importers buy Iranian dates through Dubai

Pakistan grows its own dates, but Iranian Mazafati, Rabbi and Piarom fill a clear gap in the market – especially in the weeks before Ramadan. Buying through Aria Foods Dubai gives you Iranian quality with a simple commercial set-up: the dates are already graded and packed in our Dubai warehouse, the contract and invoice come from our UAE company, and payment goes through UAE banks in US dollars or dirhams.
Built for container buyers

We sell to importers, wholesalers and food manufacturers who order at least one 20 ft container. Mazafati travels in reefer containers to stay soft; Rabbi, Piarom, Zahedi, date paste and date syrup travel in dry containers. Regular buyers can combine two or three varieties in one container.
Packing for the Pakistani market

Standard export packing is 5 kg and 10 kg cartons for wholesale markets, and 30 kg bags for repackers and processors. For retail chains we pack 250 g to 1 kg consumer packs under your brand, with English and Urdu labels.
Price and payment

We quote CFR Karachi or Port Qasim, or FOB Jebel Ali if you arrange your own freight. Every inquiry gets a written offer with the price, validity and loading date. Payment is by bank transfer or letter of credit through your bank, with the contract issued by our UAE company.
pakistan.faq:
Q: What is the minimum order for Pakistan?
A: One 20 ft container per order. A 20 ft container carries up to about 15 tonnes of packed dates and a 40 ft container 25 tonnes or more, depending on the variety and packing.
Q: How fast can you deliver to Pakistan?
A: Orders are loaded from our Dubai warehouse, usually within a few working days of payment, and the sailing from Jebel Ali to Karachi takes three to five days.
Q: Which destinations in Pakistan do you ship to?
A: Karachi Port and Port Qasim, with onward rail or road to dry ports in Lahore, Faisalabad and other cities.
Q: How do I pay?
A: Our UAE company issues the contract and invoice. You pay by bank transfer in US dollars or dirhams, or by letter of credit opened through your bank in Pakistan.
Q: Are the dates really from Iran?
A: Yes. Every shipment carries a certificate of origin stating Iran, together with the phytosanitary and health certificates, invoice, packing list and transport document.
Q: Can you pack under our own brand for Pakistan?
A: Yes. We pack consumer packs from 250 g to 1 kg under your label, with English and Urdu labelling.
Q: Which dates sell best in Pakistan?
A: Mazafati (Kimia) is the best seller before Ramadan. Rabbi sells well in wholesale markets, Piarom in dry-fruit shops and for gifting, and Zahedi for repacking and processing.

kazakhstan.h1: Iranian dates for importers in Kazakhstan – full loads from our Dubai warehouse
kazakhstan.lead: Mazafati, Piarom, Zahedi and Sayer dates by the container for importers and distributors in Almaty, Astana and Shymkent. Invoiced by our UAE company, loaded from Dubai stock and delivered by sea and rail or road.
kazakhstan.seo_title: Iranian Dates for Kazakhstan – From Dubai | Aria Foods
kazakhstan.seo_desc: Wholesale Iranian dates for Kazakhstan: Mazafati, Piarom, Zahedi and Sayer by the container from Dubai stock to Almaty, Astana and Shymkent.
ports: Southern Kazakhstan and the largest wholesale market
kazakhstan.transit: Kazakhstan is reached by sea and land: the container leaves Dubai by sea and continues by rail or truck to your city. We quote the current route and transit time with each offer.
kazakhstan.terms: CPT or DAP Almaty / Astana, or FOB Jebel Ali

season.title: Ramadan 2027 starts around 8 February
season.text: Date sales in Kazakhstan rise for the New Year holidays and again before Ramadan. Because the route combines sea and land, book your loads by early November.

varieties: Soft dark date for supermarkets, bazaars and Ramadan.
Premium semi-dry date that keeps well on long routes.
Dry golden date at an economical price for bazaars and repackers.
Semi-soft amber date for mass-market packs.
Bulk paste for confectionery and bakery producers.
docs: Commercial invoice from our UAE company
Packing list and transport documents (bill of lading, rail waybill or CMR)
Support for your EAEU declaration of conformity
kazakhstan.buyer: Your customs broker clears the cargo and registers the EAEU (EAC) declaration of conformity; labels must be in Kazakh and Russian. We prepare the full document set and the information needed for the declaration before loading.
content: Why importers in Kazakhstan buy Iranian dates through Dubai

Iranian dates are a familiar product in Kazakhstan, from Mazafati in supermarkets to Zahedi and Sayer in the bazaars. Buying through Aria Foods Dubai gives you a UAE contract and invoice, payment through UAE banks, and stock that is already graded and packed in our Dubai warehouse.
Built for full-load buyers

We sell to importers and distributors who order at least one 20 ft container. Soft Mazafati travels in reefer containers; Piarom, Zahedi, Sayer and date paste travel in dry containers and handle the long route well.
Packing and EAEU labelling

Whole dates are packed in 5 kg and 10 kg cartons for wholesale, or in consumer packs from 250 g to 1 kg under your brand. Labels are prepared in Kazakh and Russian to EAEU requirements, to your specification.
Price, delivery and payment

We quote CPT or DAP Almaty or Astana, or FOB Jebel Ali if you use your own forwarder. Each offer states the route and estimated transit time. Payment is by bank transfer in US dollars or dirhams, or by letter of credit through a UAE bank.
kazakhstan.faq:
Q: What is the minimum order for Kazakhstan?
A: One 20 ft container per order. A 20 ft container carries up to about 15 tonnes of packed dates and a 40 ft container 25 tonnes or more, depending on the variety and packing.
Q: How fast can you deliver to Kazakhstan?
A: Loads leave our Dubai warehouse within a few working days of payment. The combined sea and land route to Almaty usually takes about three to five weeks; each offer states the current transit time.
Q: Which destinations in Kazakhstan do you ship to?
A: Almaty and Astana, and Shymkent and other cities on request.
Q: How do I pay?
A: Our UAE company issues the contract and invoice. You pay by bank transfer in US dollars or dirhams, or by letter of credit through a UAE bank.
Q: Are the dates really from Iran?
A: Yes. Every shipment carries a certificate of origin stating Iran, together with the phytosanitary and health certificates, invoice, packing list and transport document.
Q: Can you pack under our own brand for Kazakhstan?
A: Yes. We pack consumer packs from 250 g to 1 kg under your label, with Kazakh and Russian labelling to EAEU requirements.
Q: Which dates sell best in Kazakhstan?
A: Mazafati for supermarkets and Ramadan, Piarom for premium shops, and Zahedi and Sayer for bazaars and repackers.

local.label: Русский
local.title: Мы – оптовый экспортёр иранских фиников
paras: Aria Foods экспортирует иранские финики и продукты из фиников. Мы поставляем импортёрам и дистрибьюторам Казахстана финики Мазафати, Пиаром, Захеди и Сайер, а также финиковую пасту оптом.
Товар хранится на нашем складе в Дубае. Контракт и инвойс выставляет наша компания в ОАЭ, а груз доставляется в Алматы или Астану морем и далее по железной дороге или автотранспортом.
Сообщите сорт, упаковку, объём и пункт назначения – мы пришлём письменное предложение в течение одного рабочего дня. Переписку мы ведём на английском языке.
points: Минимальный заказ: один 20-футовый контейнер (около 15 тонн)
Только оптовые и экспортные заказы – без розницы
Оплата: TT или аккредитив (LC) через банки ОАЭ, в долларах США или дирхамах
Все документы готовы до отгрузки: сертификат происхождения, фитосанитарный сертификат и сертификат качества
Производство сертифицировано по ISO 22000, ISO 9001 и HACCP
